model.preprocessing: rectify using pair-specific calibration; resize to training shape
model.padding: internal convolution zero padding; no external padding
model.output: left rectified disparity in pixels at the input resolution
model.output_to_original: bilinear resize and multiply disparity by original_width / model_width
model.confidence: maximum coarse disparity softmax probability, not calibrated accuracy
model.geometry: use original-resolution calibrated Q including principal-point shift
